steps.name: Check fixed source and archive refusal controls
steps.run:
python3 -m pip install -r tools/requirements.lock
python3 -m unittest tools.tests.test_go_logging_replay

steps.name: Prepare existing compiler namespace without installing a compiler
steps.run:
sudo apt-get update
sudo apt-get install --yes bubblewrap
sudo sysctl -w kernel.apparmor_restrict_unprivileged_userns=0

steps.name: Replay the normal baseline then build only current logging
Retain bounded replay observations without signing keys or raw streams

with.name: go-logging-replay-${{ github.sha }}
with.path:
${{ runner.temp }}/go-logging-replay/replay.json
${{ runner.temp }}/go-logging-replay/FAILED.json
${{ runner.temp }}/go-logging-replay/original/logging-FAILED.json
${{ runner.temp }}/go-logging-replay/original/logging-node-FAILED.json
${{ runner.temp }}/go-logging-replay/original/native/qualification.json
